_comment: Config for pipeline/cities.py + pipeline/read_city.py. Sheet corners (lon/lat) and the compilation note are read verbatim off each sheet's own printed margin by eye (checked against the U502 series' 1 deg lat x 1.5 deg lon span); pixel positions of the neatline are auto-detected at run time by scripts/georef.find_sheet_neatline on the downloaded scan, not hardcoded here.
source: US Army Map Service via Perry-Castaneda Library, UT Austin (https://maps.lib.utexas.edu/maps/ams/india/)

cities.name: Bengaluru
cities.note: Built separately (city plan 1:25,000 + front sheet 1:250,000); see CLAUDE.md. Not processed by pipeline/cities.py.

cities.name: Chennai
cities.compiled_note: Prepared by the Army Map Service (LD), Corps of Engineers, U.S. Army, Washington, D.C. Compiled in 1954 from: One-Inch Series, 1:63,360, Directorate of Military Survey, revised 1941; Half-Inch Series, 1:126,720, Survey of India, surveyed 1916-17; Half-Inch Series, 1:126,720, Directorate of Military Survey, revised 1943; USHO Charts 2433, 2434, 1948. Road classification should be referred to with caution. Railroads shown are affiliated with the Southern Railway System. Vegetation information is generally unreliable. Names for symbolized populated places are omitted where information is not available or where density of detail does not permit their inclusion.

cities.name: Hyderabad
cities.compiled_note: Prepared by the Army Map Service (LUBM), Corps of Engineers, U.S. Army, Washington, D.C. Compiled in 1954 from: India, 1:25,000, Directorate of Military Survey, Sheets 1, 2, 3, and 4, 1945; Half-inch Series, 1:126,720, Survey of India, Calcutta, 1917-44. Additional planimetric detail from: Hyderabad City and Suburbs, 1:38,400, Zindatilismat Fine Art Litho Works, Hyderabad, 1937; One Inch Series, 1:63,360; Survey of India, 56 K5, 1944; Half-inch Series, 1:126,720, Survey of India, 1917-45. Road classification should be referred to with caution. Vegetation information is generally unreliable. Names for symbolized populated places are omitted where information is not available or where density of detail does not permit their inclusion.

cities.name: Mumbai
cities.compiled_note: Prepared by the Army Map Service (GURC), Corps of Engineers, U.S. Army, Washington, D.C. Compiled in 1954 from: One-Inch Series, 1:63,360, Directorate of Military Survey, 1926-44; Half-Inch Series, 1:126,720, Survey of India, 1929-30; British Admiralty Chart 738, 1907-08; USHO Chart 2460, 1939; French Hydrographic Chart 5261, 1905. Planimetric detail revised by photo-planimetric methods. Road classification should be referred to with caution. The reliability of vegetation information is undetermined. Names for symbolized populated places are omitted where information is not available or where density of detail does not permit their inclusion.
cities.note_on_window: Mumbai's real centre (19.076N) sits just north of this sheet's 19.0N neatline, and its well-known lakes (Vihar, Tulsi, Powai, all >19.1N) are on the next sheet north, not this one. The window is widened (0.35 deg instead of 0.15) and clipped to the sheet so it reaches south into the mainland/suburbs this sheet does cover, rather than only the harbour peninsula.

cities.name: Pune
cities.compiled_note: Prepared by the Army Map Service (RC), Corps of Engineers, U.S. Army, Washington, D.C. Compiled in 1954 from Half-Inch Series, 1:126,720, Survey of India, 1925-28. Planimetric detail revised by photo-planimetric methods. Road classification should be referred to with caution. Numerous wells exist in this area and only the most important have been shown. The reliability of vegetation information is undetermined. Names for symbolized populated places are omitted where information is not available or where density of detail does not permit their inclusion.
